summary: This directory manages comprehensive ZIP archive operations including creation, extraction, reading, and structural comparison. It serves as the primary interface for interacting with ZIP archives, encapsulating both high-level services and low-level parsing logic.
responsibilities: Provide a unified service for ZIP archive manipulation
Orchestrate ZIP entry reading and stream processing
relationships: The ZipService leverages internal utilities to execute archive operations.
Comparison workflows coordinate the interaction between multiple archive entries.
Internal parsing logic provides the data foundations for high-level archive services.
designDecisions: Encapsulation of archive lifecycle management within a service class
Modular separation of comparison and extraction logic
